children: U.S. defense tech firm's fiscal Q1 revenue rose 6%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q1 beat consensus, rising to $0.59 from $0.32 last yr
Company's net loss narrowed, driven by higher gross margin and lower operating expenses
AeroVironment maintains fiscal 2027 revenue guidance of $2.125 bln to $2.225 bln
Company expects fiscal 2027 net income of $10 mln to $27 mln
AeroVironment sees fiscal 2027 non-GAAP EPS of $3.02 to $3.34
HIGHER PRODUCT AND SERVICE SALES - Co said Q1 revenue growth was due to increased product sales of $15.5 mln and higher service revenue of $10.3 mln
LOWER NON-CASH EXPENSES - Gross margin improvement was primarily due to a decrease in intangible amortization and other non-cash purchase accounting expenses

REDUCED OPERATING EXPENSES - Co attributed lower operating loss to decreased selling, general and administrative expense, including lower acquisition-related and amortization costs, and reduced R&D expense
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 19 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the aerospace & defense peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for AeroVironment, Inc. is $229.50, about 54.3% above its September 8 closing price of $148.78
The stock recently traded at 41 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 51 three months ago
